The '''Kastolar sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

[[Jollin Resbin]] represented the sector in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].<ref name="hnn">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|55|regional/1359_1.html|Campaigning Reports from the Mid Rim}}</ref>
